description: Compact module library for LLM-assisted modular time-series forecasting. Each module only includes a minimal English functional description.

A_input_sequence_processing.role: Standardize the sequence using mean and standard deviation.
Apply reversible instance normalization to each sample.
Compute first-order or lagged differences of the sequence.
Decompose the sequence into trend and residual components.
Split the sequence into fixed-length patches.
Apply masks to selected positions or variables.

B_structure_modeling.role: Model the mapping from history to future with a linear transformation.
Apply multilayer perceptrons for nonlinear feature mapping.
Extract local temporal features with one-dimensional convolution.
Model temporal dependencies with dilated causal convolutions.
Update hidden states recurrently with gated recurrent units.
Update hidden states recurrently with gated memory cells.
Represent sequence dynamics with state-space recurrence.
Encode sequence representations with self-attention and feed-forward layers.
Represent forecasts through combinations of basis functions.

C_prediction_generation.role: Map hidden representations to forecasts with a linear projection.
Map hidden representations to forecasts through multilayer perceptrons.
Project coefficients onto basis functions to generate forecasts.

D_output_adaptation.role: Restore values from Z-score standardized scale.
Reconstruct sequence values from differenced outputs.
Recombine predicted components into the final output.

E_composition_paradigm.role: Use one structure module for modeling.
Connect multiple structure modules in sequence.
Run multiple branches in parallel and add their outputs.
Use a residual branch to correct the main branch output.
Fuse multiple branch outputs using learned gating weights.
